summary: Request Emporia's most recently completed UTC hour rather than the open current hour from one clock snapshot per collection, auto-discover current Emporia devices when a setup omits device_gid, validate and deduplicate discovered GIDs, and fail closed when discovery supplies no usable GIDs, with regression coverage for each behavior.
reason: Live acceptance showed that collection requested the current hourly bucket and then correctly discarded it as incomplete, which meant the Go collector could never persist Emporia readings. The deployed Python collector also discovers all current Emporia devices, whereas the Go collector sent an empty device identifier when device_gid was omitted.
validated_outcome: Each Emporia collection snapshots its clock once before discovery and uses the same completed UTC hour for every discovered device, accepts only nonblank string or nonnegative integer identifiers, deduplicates discovered identifiers, fails with an upstream error if no usable GID remains, retains a completed returned hour, and still rejects a current partial hour. Explicit configured device_gid bypasses discovery. Focused and full Go tests, race tests, vet, build, format, and diff checks pass.
